name: Brick-based Sparse Voxel Lookup with Open-Addressing Hash
definition: A GPU-friendly sparse voxel storage and lookup scheme that groups active voxels into 8x8x8 bricks, stores brick occupancy as 512-bit bitsets, and maps brick coordinates to compact voxel/QEF arrays via an open-addressing hash table.
summary: Brick-based Sparse Voxel Lookup with Open-Addressing Hash is a GPU-friendly sparse voxel storage scheme that groups active voxels into 8x8x8 bricks and maps coordinates via an open-addressing hash table.
